arStrings.szText: You can now Channel {c_important}Apocalypse{/c} for up to {c_number}[{SF_24}|2|]{/c} seconds to build up the final explosion and rain down {c_important}{u}Brimstones{/u}{/c} which deal {c_number}{payload:BS_PAYLOAD_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage. Each second increases the final damage, up to {c_number}[{SF_24}/{SF_23}*{SF_25}*100|%|]{/c} bonus damage.

{c_important}Apocalypse{/c} launches a hellfire blast with at least {c_number}{SF_13}{/c} Stacks that deals {c_number}{payload:DOOM_IMPACT}{/c} damage. {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skill hits generate up to {c_number}{SF_17}{/c} Stacks, each Stack increases the blast's explosion size and damage by {c_number}[{SF_15}*100|x%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Apocalypse{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skill, creating a field of Abyssal Mines which arm after {c_number}[{SF_19}|1|]{/c} seconds and each deal {c_number}{payload:TRAP_DAMAGE}{/c} damage when an enemy triggers them.
{c_important}Apocalypse's{/c} final hit deals an additional {c_number}[{SF_28}*100|%|]{/c} of its damage split amongst all enemies in the area.

Enemies that survive {c_important}Apocalypse{/c} take {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage from you for {c_number}{SF_31}{/c} seconds. This bonus lasts {c_number}[{SF_38}*100|%|]{/c} longer against {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemies.

{c_important}Apocalypse's{/c} final hit has a {c_number}[{SF_32}*100|%|]{/c} chance to hit twice. When {c_important}Apocalypse{/c} is empowered by {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} this chance is increased to {c_number}[100|%|]{/c}.
{c_important}Apocalypse{/c} deals up to {c_number}[{SF_33}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage the closer enemies are to its center.
